errors.evidence: The description omits the overall purpose of the charts. It should state that the plots show the effect of the parameters α (alpha) and p on the BLEU score for a speech translation task.

The peak value for the left chart at α=0.5 is visually at the same level as the peak in the right chart (at p=0.15), which is approximately 28.53. The reported value of 28.55 is an overestimation and inconsistent with the other reported peak.
The data point at p=0.25 has a BLEU value slightly above the 28.4 tick mark, approximately 28.41. The reported value of 28.43 is a noticeable overestimation.
The data point at p=0.45 has a BLEU value that is visually closer to 28.42. The reported value of 28.44 is a slight overestimation.
